v.t: Blessed is He in whose hand is the sovereignty, and Who has power over everything
v.l: Tabaraka Al-Ladhi Biyadihi Al-Mulku Wa Huwa `Ala Kulli Shay'in Qadirun

v.t: He who created death and life—to test you—as to which of you is better in conduct. He is the Almighty, the Forgiving
v.l: Al-Ladhi Khalaqa Al-Mawta Wa Al-Hayaata Liyabluwakum 'Ayyukum 'Ahsanu `Amalaan Wa Huwa Al-`Azizu Al-Ghafuru

v.t: He who created seven heavens in layers. You see no discrepancy in the creation of the Compassionate. Look again. Can you see any cracks
v.l: Al-Ladhi Khalaqa Sab`a Samawatin Tibaqaan Ma Tara Fi Khalqi Ar-Rahmani Min Tafawutin Farji`i Al-Basara Hal Tara Min Futurin

v.t: Then look again, and again, and your sight will return to you dazzled and exhausted
v.l: Thumma Arji`i Al-Basara Karratayni Yanqalib 'Ilayka Al-Basaru Khasi'aan Wa Huwa Hasirun

v.t: We have adorned the lower heaven with lanterns, and made them missiles against the devils; and We have prepared for them the punishment of the Blaze
v.l: Wa Laqad Zayyanna As-Sama'a Ad-Dunya Bimasabiha Wa Ja`alnaha Rujumaan Lilshayatini Wa 'A`tadna Lahum `Adhaba As-Sa`iri

v.t: For those who reject their Lord, there is the torment of Hell. What an evil destination
v.l: Wa Lilladhina Kafaru Birabbihim `Adhabu Jahannama Wa Bi'sa Al-Masiru

v.t: When they are thrown into it, they will hear it roaring, as it seethes
v.l: Idha 'Ulqu Fiha Sami`u Laha Shahiqaan Wa Hiya Tafuru

v.t: It almost bursts with fury. Every time a batch is thrown into it, its keepers will ask them, “Has no warner come to you?”
v.l: Takadu Tamayyazu Mina Al-Ghayzi Kullama 'Ulqiya Fiha Fawjun Sa'alahum Khazanatuha 'Alam Ya'tikum Nadhirun

v.t: They will say, “Yes, a warner did come to us, but we disbelieved, and said, ‘God did not send down anything; you are very much mistaken.’”
v.l: Qalu Bala Qad Ja'ana Nadhirun Fakadhabna Wa Qulna Ma Nazzala Allahu Min Shay'in 'In 'Antum 'Illa Fi Đalalin Kabirin

v.t: And they will say, “Had we listened or reasoned, we would not have been among the inmates of the Blaze.”
v.l: Wa Qalu Law Kunna Nasma`u 'Aw Na`qilu Ma Kunna Fi 'Ashabi As-Sa`iri

v.t: So they will acknowledge their sins. So away with the inmates of the Blaze
v.l: Fa`tarafu Bidhanbihim Fasuhqaan Li'shabi As-Sa`iri

v.t: As for those who fear their Lord in secret—for them is forgiveness and a great reward
v.l: Inna Al-Ladhina Yakhshawna Rabbahum Bil-Ghaybi Lahum Maghfiratun Wa 'Ajrun Kabirun

v.t: Whether you keep your words secret, or declare them—He is Aware of the inner thoughts
v.l: Wa 'Asirru Qawlakum 'Aw Ajharu Bihi 'Innahu `Alimun Bidhati As-Suduri

v.t: Would He not know, He Who created? He is the Refined, the Expert
v.l: Ala Ya`lamu Man Khalaqa Wa Huwa Al-Latifu Al-Khabiru

v.t: It is He who made the earth manageable for you, so travel its regions, and eat of His provisions. To Him is the Resurgence
v.l: Huwa Al-Ladhi Ja`ala Lakumu Al-'Arđa Dhalulaan Famshu Fi Manakibiha Wa Kulu Min Rizqihi Wa 'Ilayhi An-Nushuru

v.t: Are you confident that the One in heaven will not cause the earth to collapse beneath you as it spins
v.l: A'amintum Man Fi As-Sama'i 'An Yakhsifa Bikumu Al-'Arđa Fa'idha Hiya Tamuru

v.t: Or are you confident that the One in Heaven will not unleash against you a violent storm? Then you will know what My warning is like
v.l: Am 'Amintum Man Fi As-Sama'i 'An Yursila `Alaykum Hasibaan Fasata`lamuna Kayfa Nadhiri

v.t: Those before them also denied the truth; and how was My disapproval
v.l: Wa Laqad Kadhaba Al-Ladhina Min Qablihim Fakayfa Kana Nakiri

v.t: Have they not seen the birds above them, spreading their wings, and folding them? None holds them except the Compassionate. He is Perceiver of everything
v.l: Awalam Yaraw 'Ila At-Tayri Fawqahum Saffatin Wa Yaqbiđna Ma Yumsikuhunna 'Illa Ar-Rahmanu 'Innahu Bikulli Shay'in Basirun

v.t: Or who is this who is a force for you to protect you against the Compassionate? The disbelievers are in nothing but delusion
v.l: Amman Hadha Al-Ladhi Huwa Jundun Lakum Yansurukum Min Duni Ar-Rahmani 'Ini Al-Kafiruna 'Illa Fi Ghururin

v.t: Or who is this that will provide for you, if He withholds His provision? Yet they persist in defiance and aversion
v.l: Amman Hadha Al-Ladhi Yarzuqukum 'In 'Amsaka Rizqahu Bal Lajju Fi `Utuwin Wa Nufurin

v.t: Is he who walks bent on his own design better guided, or he who walks upright on a straight path
v.l: Afaman Yamshi Mukibbaan `Ala Wajhihi 'Ahda 'Amman Yamshi Sawiyaan `Ala Siratin Mustaqimin

v.t: Say, “It is He who produced you; and made for you the hearing, and the vision, and the organs. But rarely do you give thanks.”
v.l: Qul Huwa Al-Ladhi 'Ansha'akum Wa Ja`ala Lakumu As-Sam`a Wa Al-'Absara Wa Al-'Af'idata Qalilaan Ma Tashkuruna

v.t: Say, “It is He who scattered you on earth, and to Him you will be rounded up.”
v.l: Qul Huwa Al-Ladhi Dhara'akum Fi Al-'Arđi Wa 'Ilayhi Tuhsharuna

v.t: And they say, “When will this promise be fulfilled, if you are truthful?”
v.l: Wa Yaquluna Mata Hadha Al-Wa`du 'In Kuntum Sadiqina

v.t: Say, “Knowledge is with God, and I am only a clear warner.”
v.l: Qul 'Innama Al-`Ilmu `Inda Allahi Wa 'Innama 'Ana Nadhirun Mubinun

v.t: But when they see it approaching, the faces of those who disbelieved will turn gloomy, and it will be said, “This is what you used to call for.”
v.l: Falamma Ra'awhu Zulfatan Si'at Wujuhu Al-Ladhina Kafaru Wa Qila Hadha Al-Ladhi Kuntum Bihi Tadda`una

v.t: Say, “Have you considered? Should God make me perish, and those with me; or else He bestows His mercy on us; who will protect the disbelievers from an agonizing torment?”
v.l: Qul 'Ara'aytum 'In 'Ahlakaniya Allahu Wa Man Ma`i 'Aw Rahimana Faman Yujiru Al-Kafirina Min `Adhabin 'Alimin

v.t: Say, “He is the Compassionate. We have faith in Him, and in Him we trust. Soon you will know who is in evident error.”
v.l: Qul Huwa Ar-Rahmanu 'Amanna Bihi Wa `Alayhi Tawakkalna Fasata`lamuna Man Huwa Fi Đalalin Mubinin

v.t: Say, “Have you considered? If your water drains away, who will bring you pure running water?”
v.l: Qul 'Ara'aytum 'In 'Asbaha Ma'uukum Ghawraan Faman Ya'tikum Bima'in Ma`inin
